result.rationale: JLC Terminal One is Swiss Life's co-investment vehicle for JFK New Terminal One, not a separate asset. Swiss Life's disclosed 0.4% look-through interest entered in November 2022 and sits inside JLC's 30%; it is not additive to the 100% sponsor cap table. Current direct sponsor ownership is Ferrovial 49%, JLC 30%, Ullico 19% and Carlyle 2%, with no later equity change found through the cutoff.
